user_observations.verbatim: This support, this D support on this rail cavity removed perfectly. It was great. It came off as a single piece and it pried out just as easily as the others.
And as far as fit goes, it looks like we're in really good shape here. Like we've got plenty of clearance, and in fact, it might be a little bit loose at this point.
But I don't want to change anything yet. I'd rather see how it feels on the larger full enclosure first before making adjustments, because this still seems pretty good.

visual_observations: The detached support remains a single mat with connected tree trunks. The cavity underside appears intact. The matching coupon is engaged in the channel.
scope: Coupon-scale support removal and sliding fit only. Full-length enclosure stiffness, accumulated dimensional error and full enclosure fit remain untested.
